Yahoo then shows four zero-volume bars (13-16 Oct) at an identical close with regularMarketTime unchanged -- either a data-feed gap or a trading halt; treat the price as POSSIBLY STALE and verify at the next regular close (stockanalysis/aastocks/Google Finance were unreachable from this machine).
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,478.134m = weighted average for diluted EPS, H1 FY2026 interim note (2555.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:2107): 1,472.159m basic (issued 1,477.634m less 5.5m treasury shares held by the Tongchuang Gongjin pre-IPO incentive platform) + 5.975m dilutive scheme shares. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, no other dilutive instruments exist, no buyback programme.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% + beta 1.15 x ERP 7.0% (mature-market 4.5% + ~2.5% China country/capital-control premium) = 9.85%, rounded to 10.0%. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. The country premium is charged here ONCE; operating risk (price war, franchisee churn, coffee/overseas execution) is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate, and all three scenarios use the same 10.0%.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Full lease cash (FY2025 principal RMB45.886m in financing + interest RMB3.635m = RMB49.521m, 0.92% of revenue) is charged inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB67.6m at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for the tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 PPE 25.268 + intangibles 29.652 = RMB54.9m, 1.02% of revenue; ROU depreciation 46.729 excluded).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI (55% ChaPanda Korea, 67% Senmian New Materials) charged ONCE as a bridge deduction of the NCI book value RMB37.013m at 30-Jun-2026 (interim balance sheet line 1646). Flows are modelled on a consolidated basis; NCI profit share is small (RMB8.4m of RMB344.7m in H1 FY2026, 2.4%).
inputs.net_cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents RMB2,964.278m + current FVTPL unlisted funds RMB30.262m (realisable within 12 months) = RMB2,994.54m at 30-Jun-2026; zero bank borrowings (interim line 799). Non-current financial assets are carried separately in equity_bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon (franchise supply-chain business whose margin is being reset by the price war and coffee profit-sharing; year-5 margin is not yet mature). Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 2 (non-US operating consumer company) plus owner-fcf-adaptations.md: currency (CNY flows / HKD quote), leases (B), NCI (bridge), matching-asset rule (FVTOCI/FVTPL portfolio in the bridge because its income is outside the flows), near-zero SBC. OWNER FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 595.387 (OCF 680.407 - capex 85.020 [PPE 23.957 + intangibles 61.063]) - SBC 11.982 - interest income 0 - lease cash 49.521 = 533.9. Interest income is 0 here not because it is immaterial (bank interest RMB34.9m + FVTPL interest 14.0m) but because both are presented in INVESTING activities (FY2025 cash flow lines 3595/3598) and the FVTPL fair-value gain (69.3m) is reversed out of OCF, so reported OCF/FCF already excludes them; deducting again would strip the cash pile's income twice. The matching assets (cash, funds, listed equities) are all in net cash or the bridge. WORKING CAPITAL: FY2025 OCF carried a -RMB198m working-capital outflow (contract liabilities -83m as franchise prepayments unwind with slower signups, payables -96m) and H1 FY2026 another -265m (receivables/prepayments +189m); contract liabilities are now down to RMB96m so the deferred-revenue drain is largely exhausted, but growth consumes cash for this distributor -> wc_capture NEGATIVE in every scenario. Component-built Y1 owner-FCF margin ~12% vs FY2025 actual 9.9% (13.6% before working capital) and a 14.9% net margin: the gap to FY2025 is the one-off WC unwind, deliberately not carried forward. TAX: FY2025 effective 17.6% (PRC EIT 25% less RMB83.6m Western Region 15% concession); cash taxes paid 16.3%; base ramps 17.5% -> 20% by Y6 as the concession becomes less certain, bear goes to the 25% statutory rate. TTM (FY2025 + H1 FY2026 - H1 FY2025): revenue RMB5,550m, attributable NI RMB815m. MARKET CHECK at the quote in current_price converted at fx_rate (~RMB3.4/share): market cap ~RMB5.1bn; less net cash 2.99bn and bridge ~0.44bn = operating EV ~RMB1.65bn = ~2.0x FY2025 EBITDA, ~3.1x FY2025 owner FCF, P/E 6.2x TTM. The market is paying roughly 1x book for the cash and almost nothing for the franchise; net cash alone is ~59% of the price. historical_growth.growth_rate_source: H1 FY2026 run-rate (revenue +6.2%, store count +4.7% YoY) decelerating; equity and FCF CAGRs are unusable as growth anchors (see notes)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 82.8% vs revenue 8.4% vs EPS -17.0%: equity is inflated by RMB2.28bn of April-2024 IPO proceeds (and a RMB1.02bn redeemable-share reclassification) and EPS is deflated by the enlarged post-IPO share count -- neither is a growth signal. Owner FCF fell from RMB1,235.5m (FY2023) to 140.2m (FY2024) to 533.9m (FY2025), -34% 2yr CAGR, driven by the FY2024 price-war earnings drop and the unwind of franchise prepayments; reported FCF shows the same shape (-32%), so SBC is not the cause (SBC is ~0.2% of revenue).
historical_growth.notes: History starts FY2021 (earliest filing), so 5-year CAGRs are unavailable; 4-year revenue CAGR 10.3% is given instead. FY2021-22 have no cash-flow data, so the owner-FCF CAGR is 2-year (FY2023-25). Owner-FCF series: FY2023 1,235.5 (reported 1,284.4 - SBC 0 - lease 48.9), FY2024 140.2 (213.1 - 12.8 - 60.1), FY2025 533.9 (595.4 - 12.0 - 49.5); interest income already outside OCF in every year. Revenue: FY2021 3,644.2 -> FY2022 4,231.7 -> FY2023 5,704.3 -> FY2024 4,918.0 (-13.8%) -> FY2025 5,395.1 (+9.7%) -> TTM 5,550.3.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +6% = H1 actual +6.2% held through H2 (store count +4.7%, coffee attach, overseas small; royalties -19.5% drag). Decelerates to 2.5% by Y9 as lower-tier-city densification saturates; overseas (72 stores) does not move the group number inside the horizon.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 reported EBITDA margin 19.8%; H1 FY2026 17.3% (gross margin -2.6pp from coffee profit-sharing) against a seasonally stronger H2 (H2 FY2025 ~21.5%) -> FY2026 ~18.8%. Recovers only to 19.5% as coffee concessions roll off and scale offsets continued fee concessions to franchisees; no return to the 25% FY2023 margin.
base.capex_rationale: Capex 1.5% of revenue vs FY2023 1.8%, FY2024 2.7%, FY2025 1.6%, H1 FY2026 0.7%; the 27 distribution centres are mostly leased (lease line carries them). D&A ex-ROU 1.0% rising to 1.1% on intangible (software) amortisation.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 10%/2.5% = 13.7x FCF; cap 15x for a structurally slower, competitively exposed franchise supplier (house default 20x reserved for mature compounders).

bull.rationale: Price war eases from 2027 as weaker chains exit (HeyTea froze signups), coffee scales to most of the 8,800 stores and lifts per-store purchases, overseas reaches a few hundred stores; royalty concessions stop; margin returns toward the ~21-22% between FY2023 and FY2025.

bear.rationale: A repeat of FY2024 (-13.8% revenue, margin 13.7%) spread over three years: price war intensifies, net store count turns negative as franchisee exits (~1,000/yr) outrun signups, royalties keep falling, coffee stays margin-dilutive, Western Region tax concession lapses after 2030. Same WACC as base -- risk is in these flows and the 30% weight, not charged again in the rate.

scenario_narratives.base: ChaPanda stays the #3 franchise tea chain with a slowly growing network (8,863 stores, +4-5%/yr fading to ~2-3%), revenue +6% in FY2026 fading to 2.5%, and EBITDA margin resetting to ~19% as coffee profit-sharing dilutes FY2026 before recovering to 19.5%. Royalty revenue keeps shrinking as a share of the mix, so the business is a goods-and-equipment supplier earning ~15% net margins on franchisee purchases. Working capital consumes cash as prepayment balances unwind. The RMB3.0bn net cash is returned (dividends resumed, FY2025 payout >100%) rather than trapped.
scenario_narratives.bull: The price war burns out the weaker brands by 2027, ChaPanda's balance sheet lets it hold franchisee economics while rivals cannot, coffee machines in 2,700+ stores become a second daypart lifting per-store purchases, overseas compounds off 72 stores, and royalty concessions end. Growth runs 7-8% for four years and margin returns to 21.5%, with a 60-80% payout.
scenario_narratives.bear: The China tea-drink price war becomes structural (Mixue scale pricing, Guming/CHAGEE squeezing the middle tier); franchisee exits exceed signups and the network shrinks ~3%/yr for two years; goods sales fall with store count and per-store volume; royalty income keeps eroding; coffee remains a margin give-away; the Western Region 15% tax concession lapses. Margin settles at 15% on a smaller base. The cash pile holds the value floor; the 2024 dividend cancellation is the reminder that it can be withheld.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the sector price war is live and FY2024 already showed what it does (-14% revenue, margin 19.8% -> 13.7%), royalty revenue is falling double digits, franchisee churn is ~1,000 exits a year, the two growth legs (coffee, overseas) are unproven pivots, and the July-2024 dividend cancellation shows the cash can be withheld. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (price war ending, coffee economics, overseas, fee recovery). Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY, converted to HKD at the quote date. The value is a cash-rich franchise supplier: at 30-Jun-2026 net cash of RMB2.99bn plus RMB0.44bn of investments is roughly RMB2.3/share (HKD2.7), and the operating business is valued on a component build that resets the margin to ~19% rather than carrying FY2023's 25% or FY2025's working-capital drag forward. Leases are an operating cost (treatment B), NCI and the investment portfolio are bridge items, interest income is excluded from flows and its assets added once. Risk is charged once: a 10% CNY cost of equity including a China country premium, plus a 30% bear weight on a scenario where revenue shrinks and margin falls to 15%. The market at the current quote is paying roughly for the cash alone, so the gap to IV is mostly the market's discount on Chinese small-cap consumer names and on whether the cash is returned -- a judgment on governance and capital access rather than on the operating forecast.
key_risks_to_valuation: Price war persistence beyond 2027 (bear case) -- revenue is tied to franchisee store count and per-store purchases, both of which fell in FY2024
Capital access/governance: the 2024 post-IPO dividend cancellation; a large share of the value is onshore cash whose return to HK-listed holders depends on payouts continuing
Royalty/franchise-fee erosion (-19.5% H1 FY2026) as the leading indicator of franchisee bargaining power
Coffee and overseas remain margin-dilutive longer than modelled
Western Region 15% EIT concession lapse (modelled to 20% base / 25% bear)
